biggest_catch: New members only — anyone who was a member in the last 24 months is ineligible — and the $100 pays only 60 days after both membership eligibility and bonus eligibility are approved; use promo code 'Bee' at application or the bonus won't attach.
catches: One-time $100 bonus is for NEW members only — defined as those who have not been a member of AdelFi Credit Union in the last 24 months.
To qualify for the one-time bonus, you must register for digital banking and enroll in eStatements.
Membership eligibility is required per official terms; the bonus is available to U.S. residents who are new members and meet the product requirements.
No minimum balance required after the required $100 opening deposit (refundable funds, not a fee).
Bonus is considered taxable income and the recipient may be responsible for any tax implications.
Special bonus offers will be deposited after 60 days for Harvest Checking once approval of membership eligibility and bonus eligibility requirements have been met.

The advertised 4.00% APY (on balances up to $5,000) has separate qualification criteria ($500 in accumulated external deposits per month, active debit/credit card) — the $100 bonus itself only requires digital banking + eStatements.
